name: Eolo
bio: An Italian boy in Harold Mellor's household, whose father sold him to Mellor for 200 lire and who had christened all seventeen of his children out of a mythological dictionary. He travelled with Mellor on the Riviera in 1898-99, bicycling over to Wilde at Napoule, and was still with him in Paris in September 1900, by which time Wilde was calling him Mellor's 'slave'. He is presumably the unnamed 'pretty Italian boy' of Wilde's first Mellor letter of 27 December 1898.
